ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all UBOs, directors, and signatories against the Consolidated United Nations Security Council Sanctions Lists, the Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) specially designated nationals list, the European Union consolidated sanctions list, the His Majesty's Treasury sanctions register, and the Central Bank of Oman's published list of prohibited persons and entities. Enhanced due diligence must be applied to any individual meeting the Financial Action Task Force (FATF)-defined politically exposed person criteria, including heads of state, senior government officials, judges, military commanders, and senior executives of state-owned enterprises; the SPC's corporate service provider must maintain an internal PEP identification policy and escalate any positive match or proximity finding to the Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU) in the Sultanate of Oman as per Royal Decree No. 30/2016.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Invest Easy, the official electronic portal of the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (MoCIIP) – www.investeasy.gov.om
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The corporate name must be lodged in Arabic and must be fully comprehensible under Omani naming rules; the Arabic name shall use a phonetic or literal transliteration of the foreign parent name only where the name does not conflict with a religious, cultural, or prohibited token. A Latin-script transliteration may be recorded as an auxiliary commercial name for trade and export purposes, but the Arabic name remains the primary registered name. The Arabic translation must be certified by an Omani licensed translator and the spelling must be consistent with the SPC's subsequent commercial registration, shipping documents, and export licenses.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Any expression containing 'Oman' unless expressly approved by MoCIIP with a ministerial resolution
Any expression referencing 'Bank', 'Finance', 'Insurance', or 'Investment Fund' without prior written approval of the Central Bank of Oman and/or the Financial Services Authority
Any expression referencing 'National', 'International', 'Arab', or 'Gulf' when combined with a conventional business activity unless the applicant proves factual nexus
Any expression referencing 'Energy', 'Oil', 'Gas', 'Mining', 'Defense', or 'Military' without sectoral regulator pre-clearance
Any expression containing obscene, religiously sensitive, or morally offensive terms under Omani public policy
An identical name to an existing registered company or a name that is deceptively similar to a registered trademark within the GCC trademark registry
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, the applicant is notified electronically through the Invest Easy portal with a stated legal ground. The applicant may, within 15 days of electronic notification, submit a formal administrative objection through the MoCIIP grievance module, attaching the rejection decision, a reasoned written memorandum, and any supporting trademark coexistence letters or judicial precedents. The Commercial Registry's Legal Opinions Committee will review the objection and issue a decision within 10 business days. If the objection is denied, the applicant may request a further ministerial appeal within 15 days of the committee's decision, and if that fails, may initiate an annulment action before the Oman Administrative Court (Department of Commercial Matters) under the Omani Code of Civil Procedure. A fresh name reservation may be filed immediately upon acceptance of an amended name; no fees are refunded.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Prohibited for an active SPC – a physical registered office inside Oman with a valid attested tenancy contract or property ownership deed is mandatory; a purely virtual desk or virtual office address is not accepted for the issuance of the Commercial Registration. A serviced office or executive suite located in a licensed business center in Muscat or in a Special Economic Zone may be used if the lease is for a physical office, includes a visible company signboard, and permits physical inspection by MoCIIP and municipal authorities. The registered address must be included in the SPC's constitutional documents and must be the location where statutory books are kept.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Moderate to high – approximately 35% in the first three years after incorporation for a foreign-owned SPC; the likelihood rises to 70% if the SPC requests added commodity codes (customs clearance) or engages in foodstuff warehousing. The market and food-safety authorities may conduct unannounced visits under the Food Safety Law and municipal commercial taxi provisions.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Commercial Companies Law of Oman, Decree No. 18/2019, as amended by Decree No. 39/2020, Chapter on Limited Liability Companies and Single Person Company; Executive Regulations No. 52/2020, Arts. 23-38
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registrar of Companies, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (MOCIIP), Sultanate of Oman
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum and Articles of Association of the Single Person Company, filed electronically through the Invest Easy portal
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital for an Omani SPC; capital must be fully subscribed and paid in accordance with the AOA. For a 100% foreign-owned SPC, proof of the paid-up capital must be credited to an escrow or suspense account at a licensed Omani bank before issuance of the Commercial Registration, and the funds may not be withdrawn until registration is complete.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the registered share capital of the Single Person Company be subscribed in full by the sole member in the amount stated in the Articles of Association and be paid into the company's escrow account maintained with a licensed Omani bank; that the registered office be and is hereby fixed at the location described in the Memorandum of Association in the Governorate of Muscat; that the persons named in the attendance list are appointed as Chief Executive Officer, Company Secretary and Authorized Bank Signatory of the company; that two authorized signatories jointly execute all banking documents, commercial contracts and government filings; and that these appointments and resolutions are effective immediately and continue until revoked by a subsequent resolution.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name Reservation and Trade Name Approval
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Business Registration Department, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (MOCIIP) through the Invest Easy online system
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Log in to Invest Easy, select new company formation, choose the Single Person Company legal form, enter Arabic and English trade names, select ISIC 4638 wholesale of dehydrated vegetables and spices, and submit the name reservation with a digital notarized passport copy. Record the reservation number and applicable timeline.
required_dossiers: Digital copy of shareholder's valid passport
Power of attorney if a resident agent acts on behalf of the foreign shareholder
Proposed trade name in English and Arabic
ISIC 4638 activity classification and business scope description
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused as identical or misleading, submit three alternate names within the same application; the Registry is required to approve one if no valid prior conflict exists.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Notarization of Constituent Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public Division, Ministry of Justice, Oman
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Memorandum and Articles of Association in Arabic with a certified English translation, have the sole member execute the documents before the Notary Public, and obtain notarial authentication. Submit a duplicate copy to the MOCIIP legal department for compatibility review of the SPC clauses with the Commercial Companies Law.
required_dossiers: Drafted Arabic Memorandum and Articles of Association
Certified English translation of the constituent documents
Name reservation certificate
Shareholder passport and prior approval letter
Evidence of share capital source and amount
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary detects missing articles or conflicting object clauses, revise and re-execute the documents before the same notary within five working days; no new incorporation file is opened.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Opening of Paid-up Capital Escrow Account
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: A commercial bank licensed by the Central Bank of Oman
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Using the name reservation certificate and the drafted AOA, open a temporary escrow or suspense account in the name of the SPC 'under incorporation' and deposit the paid-up capital into a non-withdrawable account. Obtain the bank's capital deposit confirmation letter for submission with the incorporation application.
required_dossiers: Name reservation certificate
Draft Memorandum and Articles of Association
Passport and board resolution of the foreign shareholder
Source of funds declaration and bank transfer instruction
Know-Your-Customer forms for the beneficial owner
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank rejects the documentation for personal data discrepancy, provide a corrected notarized passport translation or revised beneficial ownership declaration; the bank will issue a revised deposit confirmation within three working days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Upload Formation Application and Payment of Statutory Fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Companies, MOCIIP — Invest Easy portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upload the notarized MOA/AOA, name reservation certificate, power of attorney if any, registered office undertaking or preliminary lease, and the escrow deposit confirmation. Pay the recognized government filing fees through the Invest Easy e-payment gateway and sign the formation request electronically as the SPC member or authorized attorney.
required_dossiers: Notarized Memorandum and Articles of Association
Name reservation certificate
Power of attorney, if applicable
Registered office lease or landlord undertaking
Bank capital deposit confirmation
Valid residency or passport copy of signatories
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the system issues a deficiency query, correct the indicated fields within ten working days through the portal; if the application is refused, submit a written grievance to the MOCIIP Legal Affairs Committee, which must issue a reasoned decision within fifteen working days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issuance of Commercial Registration and Oman Chamber of Commerce Enrollment
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Commercial Registry, MOCIIP and Oman Chamber of Commerce and Industry (OCCI)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon approval, download the electronic Commercial Registration certificate from Invest Easy. Then enroll the SPC with the Oman Chamber of Commerce and Industry by presenting the CR and activity list to obtain the OCCI membership certificate and complete the corporate file for the company stamp and official seal.
required_dossiers: Approved electronic Commercial Registration certificate
Notarized MOA/AOA
Shareholder identification and no-objection certificate
Lease contract for the registered office
Company stamp/seal specifications for OCCI registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If OCCI data mismatch with the CR appears, request an amendment of the Commercial Registration at MOCIIP before re-submitting to OCCI; no penalty is imposed if the correction is completed within five working days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Municipal Sanitary, Civil Defense, and Physical Premises License
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Muscat Municipality or the relevant Governorate Municipality, in coordination with the Civil Defense and Ambulance Authority (CDAA)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the CR, lease contract, and food safety compliance statement to the municipality for a commercial food trading and storage license. Arrange an on-site inspection by municipal sanitation officers and CDAA inspectors for emergency exits, fire extinguishers, signage, product segregation, and ventilation; obtain the official premises operating certificate after satisfactory inspection.
required_dossiers: Commercial Registration certificate
Approved building lease or ownership contract
Food safety and hygiene management declaration
Fire extinguishing equipment installation receipt
Landlord no-objection letter
Copy of the responsible premises manager's civil ID or passport
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the inspection flags non-compliance, rectify the listed deficiencies within fifteen working days and request a second inspection; the municipality will issue the premises license after a clean subsequent inspection.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Environment Authority of Oman and Public Authority for Food Safety
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the environmental screening and registration form under Oman's environmental permitting regulations; for a small-scale dehydrated vegetables and spices trading and storage operation, self-classify as a Category 4 low-environmental-impact facility requiring registration rather than a full EIA. Register the premises as a food storage facility with the Public Authority for Food Safety and obtain the food safety registration certificate.
required_dossiers: Completed environmental registration and self-classification form
Contract with a licensed waste operator for food and packaging waste
Food safety plan covering storage hygiene and pest control
Ventilation and temperature control statement for spice storage
Civil defense final certificate for the premises
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Environment Authority raises a screening concern, commission a rapid environmental impact study by an accredited consultant and submit it within twenty working days; the food safety registration may be held pending receipt of the environmental no-objection document.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Directorate General of Industry, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion, together with the Public Authority for Food Safety for food storage and handling
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Commercial Food Trading and Storage License / Municipal Food Premises Operating License

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category 4 Environmental Registration — low-impact wholesale food storage and trading; no full EIA report required
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Compliance with EA Permitting Regulations: no uncontrolled wastewater discharge; indoor VOC concentration in storage and repackaging areas below 50 mg/m3; segregated disposal of food waste and plastic packaging through licensed operators; adherence to Omani waste management standards and municipal trade effluent requirements.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Civil Defense and Ambulance Authority (CDAA) fire safety certificate for the commercial premises; municipal structural load inspection for the storage facility; and Ministry of Labour workplace clearance, including food-handling health certificates for all relevant employees.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Oman Tax Authority (OTA) - official e-services portal available at https://taxoman.om
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Foreign-owned Single Person Company (SPC) registers with the Oman Tax Authority by: (1) first obtaining Commercial Registration (Sijil) from the Ministry of Commerce, Investment and Communications (MOCICID); (2) applying for a VAT Tax Registration Number (TRN) via the OTA e-services platform using the CR, Omani address proof, shareholder/officer identification and authorized signatory details; (3) separately applying for income tax registration and obtaining a Tax Card / Income Tax Identification Number within the statutory period after CR issuance or commencement of business; (4) if engaged in imports/exports, completing Royal Oman Police Customs registration and obtaining a Customs Registration Number / Economic Operator Code. All registration filings are made in Arabic/English through the OTA portal, and approved taxpayers receive an electronic VAT certificate containing the TRN.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Oman does not provide US-style 'check-the-box' or hybrid mismatch elections; a Single Person Company is per se an entity-level taxpayer with no pass-through eligibility. Available statutory elections under Omani tax law include: (a) voluntary VAT registration where taxable supplies exceed OMR 19,000 but remain below the mandatory threshold; (b) VAT group registration under the Oman VAT Law for related resident persons with close financial, economic and organizational links, permitting consolidated VAT filing; (c) income tax accounting period alignment with the CR expiry or fiscal year subject to OTA approval; and (d) no domestic hybrid mismatch election - OECD BEPS-aligned substance requirements govern treaty and source characterization.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Mandatory registration threshold: OMR 38,500 for taxable supplies (excluding VAT) over any consecutive 12-month period; voluntary registration threshold: OMR 19,000. A non-resident supplier without an Oman establishment making taxable supplies in Oman is required to register for VAT irrespective of the OMR 38,500 threshold where Omani VAT is levied or recoverable by reverse charge.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Oman has not yet implemented a mandatory real-time electronic invoice clearance API, fiscal stamping or continuous transaction control regime for VAT. Taxpayers must issue VAT-compliant invoices using OTA-accepted electronic or paper formats, retain XML/PDF or paper records, and submit periodic VAT returns through the OTA e-services portal. Digital stamping is limited to excise tobacco products and does not apply to dehydrated vegetables/spices exports. No OTA clearance gate exists at the invoice issuance stage for the bulk spice export sector; only the customs export declaration and VAT return filing are the mandatory clearance points.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating is available for goods physically exported from Oman to a destination outside Oman, or to a place outside the jurisdiction where the recipient is outside Oman, provided the exporter holds sufficient evidence that the goods left Oman within the applicable time limit (generally 90 days from the date of supply/invoice). Dehydrated garlic flakes and crushed chili pepper sold as bulk export commodities qualify for 0% VAT if the sale is a genuine export, the goods are shipped under a contract of sale, the exporter is the supplier, and the complete customs and payment evidence is retained. Directly related export freight, port and international logistics services may also be zero-rated where the recipient is outside Oman and the services are physically performed overseas or directly connected to the export.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Bayan / ACS) validated by the Royal Oman Police Customs showing the Omani port of exit
Bill of Lading, airway bill or equivalent transport document naming the Omani exporter and the foreign destination port/airport
Commercial invoice referencing the zero-rated export and containing product, quantity, unit price, total value and HS codes (e.g. 0712.90 / 0904.20)
Packing list covering the shipment contents and weight details
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank credit statement evidencing receipt of export proceeds into the Omani exporter's account
Certificate of Origin (where requested by the importing country or letter of credit conditions)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The Oman Tax Authority conducts retrospective audit checks on export zero-rating, requiring a full evidence chain of the customs export declaration, transport documents and the inward remittance certificate within 180 days of shipment. Failure to substantiate physical export leads to VAT reassessment at 5% on the gross supply, clawback of any input VAT previously recovered, late-payment penalties (assessed on a per-day basis as provided under the VAT Law), fixed administrative fines up to OMR 5,000 for record-keeping/invoice failures, and more severe criminal liability, including imprisonment and higher fines, for fraudulent export schemes. The limitation period for OTA assessment and clawback is generally five years from the end of the relevant tax period.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Omani Rial (OMR) is fully convertible for current-account transactions including trade settlements, service fees, and profit repatriation, subject to standard bank documentation and anti-money laundering verification. Capital-account flows, including inbound equity injections and shareholder loans, are freely permitted for registered foreign-owned entities but must be routed through licensed authorized dealers and supported by underlying corporate resolutions and proof of beneficial ownership. Dividend and profit remittances require audited financials, tax clearance from the Oman Tax Authority, and a board resolution; no quantitative limits or import-behind-export compensation rules apply.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Under CBO regulations, there is no mandatory currency surrender ratio or forced conversion percentage for export receipts; however, all export proceeds must be repatriated to Oman and credited to a CBO-licensed commercial bank account owned by the exporter within 90 days of the bill of lading date. The exporter may retain foreign currency balances in an approved foreign-currency account or convert to OMR as commercially required. Non-repatriation without prior CBO approval constitutes a exchange control violation subject to fines and bank restrictions.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account + Trade Finance Escrow Sub-Account
Operational Account with dedicated cross-border transaction desk

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Offshore digital EMI (Electronic Money Institution) accounts are not permissible as primary clearing rails for this export entity. CBO Circular BM/1130 and the Payment Systems Act require any payment service provider serving Oman-resident corporate exporters to hold an active payment service provider license issued by CBO and to maintain a physical or licensed agency presence in Oman. Offshore EMIs without CBO license or correspondent banking sponsorship from a licensed Omani bank receive a Low feasibility rating; they may be used only as supplemental collection agents, and full treasury settlement must flow through a licensed Omani bank account.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Personal physical appearance of at least one authorized signatory and the sole shareholder/beneficial owner is mandatory for initial account opening at all Omani commercial banks. Remote opening is not permitted under CBO Know Your Customer (KYC) rules for non-resident-owned single person companies. A sanctioned in-person interview at the bank's head office or approved regional branch is required, and an in-country compliance review will be scheduled to inspect the company's actual operating and warehousing premises before activating trade finance limits.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: 100% foreign-owned SPC with no Omani resident partner or director; bank may classify as enhanced risk due to lack of local operating footprint.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide audited (or certified) financial statements of the shareholder, valid Commercial Register extract from Oman Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (MOCIIP), Chamber of Commerce membership, planning approval for warehouse lease, evidence of commercial substance such as supplier contracts, purchase orders, and proforma invoices from dehydrated vegetables/spices suppliers. Include physical inventory inspection reports and the authorized signatory's Emirates ID or passport with Oman residence visa.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Source-of-wealth ambiguity in equity capital or shareholder loan entering the SPC within the first 12 months.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Present a complete corporate registry chain, banking references from the overseas parent bank, transaction-specific capital introduction declarations, CBO purpose code documentation, and sworn affidavit of lawful source of funds. Attach tax residence certificates and ownership declarations with trailing audit trail.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Mismatch between declared export business and observed payment flows to third‑party intermediaries or private individuals.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Maintain full underlying trade file: signed sales contracts, commercial invoices, List of Loading (packing lists), certificates of origin (Oman Chamber of Commerce), fumigation and phytosanitary certificates, shipping bills, marine insurance policies, and SWIFT MT103 records matching nominal amounts. Provide standard operating procedures showing direct receipt from overseas buyer and payment only to verified suppliers for raw garlic and chili procurement.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Bank's internal model flags low-risk tariff codes (HS 0712 for dehydrated vegetables) as potentially inconsistent with bulk trade when transaction frequency is high.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Submit a written business profile aligned to ISIC 4638 and NAICS 424490, supplier and buyer due diligence files, warehouse storage agreements, QC inspection reports, and a cash-flow forecast. Include certificates of analysis and supplier qualification reports to demonstrate physical trading substance; require bank relationship manager to file a Legal and Compliance justification memo.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound equity and capital injections from the foreign shareholder to the Oman SPC must be wired using SWIFT MT103 or MT202/202COV with the CBO balance-of-payments purpose code for Direct Investment in Oman — Equity Capital. The beneficiary account must be the SPC's capital escrow account at a CBO-licensed commercial bank. The bank will request a board resolution approving the capital increase, a share allotment list, a KYC/EDD questionnaire, and a signed capital contribution agreement. The funds are credited as soon as the reference is cleared; no prior currency conversion is mandated and the bank will open a temporary inward remittance suspense account if documents are incomplete.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For supplier payments and service fees, the documented clearing rails are SWIFT MT103 (customer-initiated transfers) for open-account disbursements and Commercial Letters of Credit (MT700/MT710) for documentary trade settlements. Export payments from foreign buyers are accepted via MT103 or documentary collections. All outbound payments must be matched against corresponding trade invoices, bills of lading, and sales contracts, and are processed through the bank's trade finance module. The bank will apply CBO transaction-monitoring thresholds and may request underlying export documents before effecting cross-border payments if the transaction size exceeds OMR 50,000 or equivalent.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable FX forwards against USD, EUR, INR, AED, and SGD up to 12 months tenor, fully backed by underlying trade exposure
Cross-currency swaps (Overnight Indexed Swaps and standard swaps) with a licensed Omani bank for arrears management on non-USD receivables
Currency options (European style) on USD/OMR, EUR/OMR, and INR/OMR purchased via a CBO-authorized dealer for hedging confirmed orders

NDFs (non-deliverable forwards) on the Omani Rial to the extent permitted by CBO circulars; available for offshore counterparties with strict substitution clauses referencing the CBO official fixing rate
Monetization of export receivables through forfaiting and factoring arrangements with recourse to a licensed Omani bank

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (MoCIIP) – Commercial Registry / InvestEasy
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually before the CR expiry date shown on the InvestEasy commercial licence; renewal opens 30 days before expiry and penalties apply after a grace period of 30 days.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-renewal surcharge, suspension of the SPC's trading licence, and administrative strike-off if the CR remains unrenewed for six months after expiry.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Year-end Audited Financial Statements (approved by the sole shareholder)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within six months after the SPC's financial year-end; for a 31 December fiscal year, filing by 30 June.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative penalty under the Commercial Companies Law and suspension of access to the electronic company file; continued default may lead to deregistration or strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Oman Tax Authority (OTA) – electronic tax portal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: No later than four months after the fiscal year-end; for a 31 December year-end, submission by 30 April.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing penalty, 1% monthly interest on unpaid tax, estimated assessment, and enforced collection by the OTA; persistent non-compliance can result in an OTA-initiated suspension of the commercial licence.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual UBO and Shareholding Register Confirmation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Simultaneously with the commercial registration renewal, and within 30 days after any share transfer or UBO change, whichever event occurs first.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: AML/CFT administrative fines, personal liability of the director/manager for false declarations, and unenforceability of an unregistered transfer against the company or third parties.

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 15% flat rate on net taxable income under the Unified Income Tax Law (Royal Decree 23/2023), applicable to Omani-resident SPCs and Oman-source income of non-residents; prior-law graduated schedule (0% up to OMR 30,000; 3% up to OMR 100,000; 15% above OMR 100,000) applied to tax years beginning before the Unified Law's effective date.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No automatic tax holiday for onshore trading SPCs. Available reliefs: (a) small-taxpayer treatment where annual gross revenue does not exceed OMR 100,000, with reduced record-keeping but mandatory registration and filing retained; (b) Sultan's-decree free-zone CIT exemptions, typically 5 to 30 years, available only where operational substance is physically relocated into an approved Omani free zone; (c) standard tax depreciation, foreign tax credit offsets, and 100% deduction of expenses that are wholly and exclusively incurred for Omani taxable income; (d) no manufacturing, agricultural, or export-specific income exemption is available for wholesale trading of dehydrated vegetables and spices. The 15% headline rate is aligned with the OECD Pillar Two minimum rate for in-scope multinational groups.
